title: NAT and PAT Troubleshooting Challenge
summary: Diagnose and resolve common Port Address Translation (PAT / NAT Overload) misconfigurations on an enterprise edge router. Identify and correct translation ACL subnet mismatches, interface boundary role errors (ip nat inside/outside), and verify end-to-end outbound Internet connectivity for multiple internal subnets using active translation tables and statistical counters.
learning_objectives: Diagnose NAT and PAT failures using Cisco IOS diagnostic commands (show ip nat translations, show ip nat statistics, show access-lists)
Identify and remediate interface boundary role misconfigurations (ip nat inside and ip nat outside)
Correct standard access control list errors that prevent internal subnets from matching NAT overload rules
Configure dynamic Port Address Translation (PAT) with interface overloading for multiple internal LANs
Verify active address translations and monitor translation table counters with live ICMP and HTTP traffic probes

source.origin: Independently authored network services troubleshooting laboratory guide based on IETF RFC 3022 standards and Cisco IOS NAT/PAT diagnostic best practices
